verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a one-time-passcode (TOTP/HOTP) generator app. User-configured autonomous background automations are a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. Automatic code syncing on sign-in is a built-in behavior, not a user-defined automation, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
